lessons.title: Furniture
goals: 🛋️ Describe the furniture in a room
'Bu nima?' va 'Bular nima?' savollariga javob berish
warmup: Look around the room. Point and say 3 things you can see. / Atrofga qarang. Ko'rgan 3 ta narsaga ishora qilib ayting.
I say 'There is a table.' The next student adds one more: 'There is a table and a lamp.' / Men bitta narsa aytaman, keyingi o'quvchi yana bittasini qo'shadi.

x: There is a bed in the bedroom.
The table is in the kitchen.
There are two chairs at the table.
There is a sofa in the living room.
There is a lamp on the desk.
The wardrobe is in my room.
I do my homework at my desk.
There is a mirror on the wall.
There is a carpet on the floor.
There is a picture above the sofa.

grammar.rule: **There is a** + one thing / **There are** + two or more
grammar.uz: Bitta narsa uchun 'there is', ko'pi uchun 'there are'
ex: There is a bed in my room.
There are three chairs in the kitchen.
**This** is my desk. **That** is the wardrobe.

practice.title: Circle the Answer

What are these? → a) It's a chair b) They are chairs c) They is chairs

practice.title: Build the Sentence

There / are / chairs / two / the / in / room / .

reading.title: My Dream Room
reading.passage: My dream room is big. There is a bed next to the window. There are two lamps — one on the desk and one next to the bed. There is a big wardrobe and a soft carpet on the floor. On the wall there is a mirror and three pictures. There is a sofa too. I love my room!

speaking.title: Talk with a Partner
table: Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.

speaking.title: Real-life Mission
speaking.body: Draw your bedroom. Show it to a partner and describe it with 'There is / There are'. / Xonangizni chizing va 'there is / there are' bilan tasvirlang.

quiz: Fill in: 'There ___ a carpet on the floor.' (is/are)
Correct the sentence: 'There is two beds.'
lessons.homework: Vocabulary: write all 10 words 3× · Grammar: 5 sentences about your room with 'There is / There are' · Reading: re-read 'My Dream Room' and answer the 4 questions in full sentences · Speaking: describe one room in your house to your family.
teacher: Show a picture of a room; students name the furniture in English.
Drill 'This/That' with real objects — near/far hand gestures.
Watch for 'there is + plural'; contrast 'There is a chair / There are chairs'.
Follow up: each student describes their own room at home.

lessons.title: Where Is It?
goals: 📍 Say where things are (on, under, next to)
🎯 Understand short answers: 'It's on the table.'
warmup: Hide a small object. Ask 'Where is it?' Students guess: 'Is it under the book?' / Kichkina narsani yashiring. O'quvchilar topishadi.
Point and say: 'There is a sofa. Where is it? — It's in the living room.' / Mebellarni takrorlang.

x: The pen is in the bag.
The book is on the table.
The cat is under the chair.
The shop is next to the school.
The ball is behind the door.
The teacher is in front of the class.
The bank is between the shop and the hospital.

grammar.uz: Bitta narsa uchun 'where is', ko'pi uchun 'where are'
ex: Where is the lamp? — It's on the desk.
Where are the shoes? — They're under the bed.
Where is the cat? — It's behind the sofa.

practice.title: Fill in the Gaps
items: Where ___ the mirror? (is/are)
Where ___ the chairs? (is/are)
The cat is ___ the sofa. (under/on)
The lamp is ___ the table. (on/in)

practice.title: Circle the Answer
items: Where is the mirror? → a) It's on the wall b) They're on the wall c) Yes, it is

practice.title: Build the Sentence
items: is / the / Where / lamp / ?
are / chairs / the / Where / ?
the / is / cat / under / The / table / .

reading.title: Ben's Room
reading.passage: Ben's room is small but nice. His bed is next to the window. His lamp is on the desk. His books are under the desk. There is a big wardrobe behind the door. His cat, Tom, is on the bed. Where are Ben's shoes? They're under the bed, of course!

listening.title: Find It!
qs: Where is the ball first? (under the chair / on the table)
listening.script: Let's play find it! Listen. The ball is under the chair. (pause) Now the ball is on the table. (pause) Now it is behind the door. (pause) Now it is next to the box.

speaking.title: Real-life Mission
speaking.body: Ask your partner where 3 things in the classroom are. / Sinfdagi 3 ta narsa qayerdaligini juftingizdan so'rang.

lessons.homework: Vocabulary: write the 8 position words 3× · Grammar: 5 questions with 'Where is/are' + answers · Reading: re-read 'Ben's Room', answer the 4 questions · Speaking: say where 3 things at home are, in English.
teacher: Play 'hide the object' to make position words physical.
Drill question word order: Where + is/are + noun.
Move a real ball as you read the listening script.
Watch for yes/no answers to where-questions; teach 'It's/They're + place'.

lessons.title: My Neighborhood
goals: 🏘️ Describe places near home (park, shop, school)
🛤️ Say 'It's near the... / It's far from...'
warmup: Look out of the window. Name 3 places you can see. / Derazadan qarang. Ko'rgan 3 ta joyni ayting.
Quick drill: 'Where is the shop?' — 'It's next to the school.' / Tezkor takrorlash.

x: There is a park near my house.
The shop is on my street.
The school is near the park.
There is a hospital far from my house.
The shop is near my house.
The school is far from here.
The bank is next to the hospital.
There is a market on Sundays.

grammar.rule: There is a park **near** my house. / The school is **far from** my house.
ex: There is a park near my house.
The hospital is far from the center.
There are many shops on this street.
mistake: Wrong: *The shop is near to my house.*
Right: *The shop is near my house.*

practice.title: Fill in the Gaps
items: There is a park ___ my house. (near/near to)
The bank is far ___ the school. (from/at)
There ___ many shops on this street. (is/are)
___ there a hospital near here? (Is/Are)

practice.title: Circle the Answer
items: Is there a bank near here? → a) Yes, there is b) Yes, there are c) Yes, it is

practice.title: Build the Sentence
items: a / near / There / is / park / my / house / .
far / is / hospital / The / from / here / .

reading.title: My Street
reading.passage: My street is nice. There is a small shop next to my house. The school is near the shop. Behind the school there is a big playground. Children play there every day. The park is far from my street, but my family goes there on Sundays. We love our neighborhood!
qs: What is next to my house?
When does the family go to the park?

listening.title: Listen and Draw
qs: Where do you draw the shop?
listening.script: Draw a picture. In the middle, draw a school. Next to the school, draw a shop. Near the shop, draw a park. Behind the park, draw a hospital. Far from the school, draw your house.

speaking.title: Talk with a Partner
table: Is there a park near your house?
Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
Is the hospital far from here?
Yes, it's far. / No, it's near.

speaking.title: Real-life Mission
speaking.body: Draw your street. Tell your partner about 4 places with 'near / far from'. / Ko'changizni chizing va 4 ta joy haqida ayting.

quiz: The hospital is far ___ the school. (from/at)
Fill in: 'There ___ many shops on this street.' (is/are)
lessons.homework: Vocabulary: 10 words 3× · Grammar: 5 sentences about places near your home (near/far from) · Reading: re-read 'My Street', answer 3 questions · Speaking: tell your family about your street.
teacher: Use a simple map on the board and drill near/far from with real positions.
Review 'there is/are' before the new 'near/far' phrases.
Watch for 'near to' — correct to 'near'.
For homework, students can draw and label a map of their street in English.

lessons.title: Design Your Room Workshop
goals: 🛠️ Design and describe a dream room
O'z orzu xonasini loyihalash va tasvirlash
🗣️ Use 'There is / There are' to present it
warmup: I describe a thing, you name it: 'You sleep on it.' → bed! / Men tasvirlayman, siz topasiz.
Review: 'Where is the lamp?' — 'It's on the desk.' / Joy so'zlarini takrorlang.

x: There is a sofa in my dream room.
The wardrobe is next to the door.
There is a lamp on the desk.
There is a mirror on the wall.
The carpet is on the floor.
There is a shelf with books.

practice.title: Design Your Room
items: Choose 5 pieces of furniture. / 5 ta mebel tanlang.
Draw the room on paper. / Xonani qog'ozga chizing.
Write 3 sentences with 'There is' and 2 with 'There are'. / 3 ta 'there is' va 2 ta 'there are' gap yozing.
Name each thing in English. / Har bir narsani inglizcha ayting.

practice.title: Circle the Answer
items: Which sentence is correct? → a) There are a bed b) There is a bed c) There is bed

speaking.title: Present Your Room
speaking.body: Show your drawing to the class. Say: 'This is my room. There is... There are...' / Xonangizni sinfga ko'rsating va tasvirlang.

speaking.title: Partner Questions

quiz: Fill in: 'There ___ a mirror on the wall.' (is/are)
Name 3 furniture words you learned today.
lessons.homework: Finish and color your room picture. Write 5 sentences about it. / Xona rasmini tugating va 5 gap yozing.
teacher: Workshop: students design a room in pairs, then present to the class.
Collect the drawings for a wall display.
Keep the pace playful — this lesson consolidates 29-32.
Encourage full sentences, not single words.

lessons.title: Prepositions
goals: 📍 Use in, on, under, next to, between
'in, on, under, next to, between'ni ishlatish
warmup: Hide something. Students ask 'Is it in/on/under...?' / Narsa yashiring, o'quvchilar savol beradi.
Name a room, students say furniture in it. / Xonani ayting, mebellarni sanang.

x: The pen is in the bag.
The book is on the table.
The cat is under the chair.
The school is next to the shop.
The bank is between the shop and the hospital.
The ball is behind the door.
The teacher is in front of the class.
The picture is above the sofa.
The shoes are inside the wardrobe.
The dog is outside the house.

grammar.rule: in, on, under, next to, between, behind, in front of + **the** + place
grammar.uz: Joy so'zlari: ichida, ustida, tagida, yonida, orasida, orqasida, oldida
ex: The school is **between** the bank and the shop.
mistake: Wrong: *The cat is under of the table.*
Right: *The cat is under the table.*

practice.title: Fill in the Gaps

practice.title: Circle the Answer
items: Where is the lamp? → a) It's on the desk b) It's under the desk c) It's in the desk

practice.title: Build the Sentence
items: is / cat / under / The / table / the / .
school / is / The / the / bank / between / and / shop / the / .

Brother asks: 'Where are my shoes?' 'They're behind the door,' says Mum. 'And the cat?' The cat is on the sofa — sleeping, of course!

Fill in: 'The picture is ___ the wall.' (on/in/under)
lessons.homework: Vocabulary: 10 position words 3× · Grammar: 6 sentences with different prepositions about your room · Reading: re-read 'Where Is Everything?', answer 4 questions · Speaking: hide an object at home and ask your family to find it.

Review L30-33 furniture/rooms so students have rich vocabulary to position.

table: Yes, there is. It's on the table.

quiz: Fill in: 'There ___ a clock on the wall.' (is/are)

teacher: Bring or draw a colorful room picture to make the vocabulary concrete.
Model a full description, then students copy the pattern for their own room.

lessons.title: Giving Directions
goals: 🧭 Give simple directions (turn left, go straight)

The school is two blocks away.
The bank is on your left.
The hospital is on your right.

grammar.rule: Imperatives: **Turn left. / Turn right. / Go straight.**
grammar.uz: Buyruq gaplar: chapga buriling, o'ngga buriling, to'g'ri yuring

practice.title: Fill in the Gaps

practice.title: Build the Sentence
items: left / Turn / the / at / shop / .
your / park / on / is / The / right / .

reading.passage: Ask for directions: 'Excuse me, where is the library?' 'Go straight ahead for two blocks. Turn left at the bank. The library is on your right, next to the park.' 'Thank you!' 'You're welcome!'
qs: How many blocks do you go straight?

listening.title: Follow the Map
listening.script: Start at the school. Go straight one block. Turn right at the corner. Go straight again. The shop is on your left. Stop there.

Draw a map on the board and practice with real locations.

Role-play polite openers: 'Excuse me, ...'.

🗣️ Use there is/are, prepositions, directions together

lessons.title: Big Numbers and Prices
goals: 🛍️ Ask and answer 'How much is it?'
'Qancha turadi?' deb so'rash va javob berish
warmup: Teacher shows an object; students guess: 'It's 500 som.' / Narxni taxmin qiling.

x: The ticket costs one thousand som.

grammar.rule: Numbers: **hundred / thousand** · Prices: **How much is/are...? — It's / They're ...**
grammar.uz: Sonlar: yuz, ming. Narx so'rash: qancha turadi?
ex: How much **is** the book? — It's five thousand som.
Kitob qancha turadi? — Besh ming som.
How much **are** the shoes? — They're cheap!

The bread is very ___. (cheap/expensive)

practice.title: Build the Sentence
items: is / How / the / much / bag / ?

reading.title: The Market
reading.passage: Today is market day! I have two thousand som. First, I buy bread — it is three hundred som. Then I buy apples — they are five hundred som. I see a nice blue bag, but it is very expensive — four thousand som! I ask: 'Is the bag cheaper?' The seller says: 'Two thousand five hundred.' I pay and get my change. Now I have no money, but I am happy!
qs: Why doesn't the boy buy the blue bag at first?

listening.title: Listen and Write the Price
listening.script: Listen and write the prices. The bread is three hundred som. The milk is five thousand five hundred som. The notebook is four thousand som. The hat is fifteen thousand som. The pencils are free for everyone!
